item.text:
This pass validated the complete fix set against the project's own test suites.

**Regression check on the fixed copy** (`audit/diag-fixes/`, all eight patches applied, generated TLS certificates in place):

```
ok  internal/transport   14.5s   (including all mutual-TLS variants)
ok  root package         46.2s
ok  internal/rsm          2.8s
ok  raftpb
```

Combined with the earlier runs, the fixed copy is green under:
- the upstream suites (root, raft, rsm, logdb, transport with TLS, raftpb, tools, client, config),
- the audit suite in default mode,
- the audit suite under `-race` (root 19.3 s, raft 37.7 s),
- the memfs/channel-transport build (root suite and audit scenarios).

That means each of the eight minimal patches — F1 wakeup, F2 duplicate record, F3 `HasUpdate`, F4 transport-factory `Validate`, F5 logger cache key, F6 parser guards, F7 chunk-header guard, F8 chunk-save error handling — resolves its reproduction without changing any behaviour the upstream tests assert.

**Handoff state**

Eight findings, each reproduced on the unmodified tree, each fixed and regression-checked in the verification copy. The audited tree remains byte-identical to `../source`; all audit files are gofmt/vet-clean.

[report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (899 lines) now includes the regression-check result alongside the findings, the F6–F8 pattern analysis, the full evidence, the reproduction inventory and the command log.
